fidelityMap.silhouette: Two-column product explanation and straight-on portal UI, replacing the old isolated device
fidelityMap.grid: Copy left; larger framed product stage right; stacked below 760px
fidelityMap.imageTopology: No device image, hardware casing, Safari chrome, angle or floating animation. Existing Cloud demo UI inside a neutral presentation panel.
fidelityMap.type: Cloud Boska display and Switzer text, readable UI labels; original licensed fonts retained
fidelityMap.palette: Light neutral section, pale blue-gray stage, white portal, Cloud ink/teal actions; no borrowed Stripe gradients
fidelityMap.interaction: Three keyboard-operable scene controls with selected state and accessible status. Selecting a scene pauses the demo; play/pause resumes. Automatic six-scene sequence remains; reduced motion stops autoplay and keeps scene selection usable.

status: REJECTED BY USER: changing the mobile-phone concept to a desktop portal is not authorized. Superseded by mobile-motion restoration.
